                    AND ads.employee = %s
                    AND ads.ref_doctype = %s
                
            """, (i.get("payroll_date"), i.get("employee"), i.get("ref_doctype")), as_dict=True)
            if opening_loan_sql[0]['amount']:
                opening_loan = i.get("sanctioned_amount") - opening_loan_sql[0]['amount']
                res["loan_opening_balance"] = opening_loan
            else:
                opening_loan = opening_loan + i.get("sanctioned_amount")

            closing_loan_sql = frappe.db.sql("""
                SELECT
                    ads.name additional_salary,
                    SUM(ads.amount) amount,
                    ads.payroll_date,
                    ads.ref_docname,

                FROM

            else:

    else:

    res["loan"] = total_loan

    res["amount_to_deduct"] = amt_to_deduct
    res["deducted_amount"] = amt_to_deduct
    res["salary_advance"] = amt_to_deduct
